name: MinIO
compose:
services:
  minio:
    image: minio/minio:latest
    command: server /data --console-address :9001
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: minioadmin
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - '9000:9000'
      - '9002:9001'
    volumes:
      - minio-data:/data
